system.description:
The hate increase value from skills with the [Instrument] tag that you use is -1 (minimum 0). (CR17) This effect does not apply. It is a lute whose sound slowly seeps into the ears, possessing a very sweet and gentle tone. So natural is its sound that it makes one forget they are listening, soothing a wounded heart and driving away hostility. The beautifully curved body of the instrument fits comfortably in the player's hands, and while some seek it as a magic item, others simply desire it as a musical instrument in its own right.

Seashell of the Surf [Core Material] (220G) + Quality Instrument (110G) + Deft Finger Charm (Intermediate) (230G) ×2 + [Magic Catalyst 11] (120G) ×2 + Crafting Cost (450G)
